requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-4549-6073--52.description:
Activate Relic of Legends by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Relic of Legends by tapping Grimgrin, adding an additional mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Angelic Sell-Sword triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

413-789-2738-4871.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Gutter Grime, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Gutter Grime trigger, creating a creature token.
When the token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 6.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Tenacious Dead enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2292-3413-5929.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Human due to Leyline of Transformation, Xathrid Necromancer triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

64-364-1987.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
64-364-1987.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Warden of the Eye.
When Warden of the Eye enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
64-364-1987.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

475-2919-3263-4186.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
475-2919-3263-4186.description:
Gain life in any way.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice.
Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

215-1879-5709.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Forests.
215-1879-5709.description:
Activate Rofellos by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Rofellos from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Rofellos by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3375-3532-5078-5957.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Kianne triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

232-5778-6751-6867.description:
Cast Priest of Urabrask by paying its mana cost plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Priest of Urabrask enters, it triggers twice and its offspring ability triggers twice due to Starfield Vocalist.
Resolve both innate Priest of Urabrask triggers, adding six {R}.
Resolve the first offspring trigger, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask that is 1/1.
When the Priest of Urabrask token enters, it triggers twice, adding six {R}.
Repeat steps 4 and 5 for the remaining offspring trigger.
Cast Appa by paying its mana cost plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Appa enters, it triggers twice and its offspring ability triggers twice.
Resolve both innate Appa triggers, airbending the nontoken Priest of Urabrask.
Resolve the first offspring trigger, creating a token copy of Appa that is 1/1.
Put the Appa token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Appa token's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, airbending nothing.
Resolve the second offspring trigger, creating a token copy of Appa that is 1/1.
Put the Appa token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Appa token's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, airbending the nontoken Appa.
Cast Priest of Urabrask from exile by paying {2} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
Repeat steps 2 through 6 once.
Cast Appa from exile by paying {2} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
Repeat from step 8.
232-5778-6751-6867.notes: Once you have extra mana, other nonland permanents can be airbended using Appa and returned to the battlefield each loop as desired.

924-2079-4149-4599-4871.easyPrerequisites: Gravespawn Sovereign is untapped or you control another untapped Zombie.
924-2079-4149-4599-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three additional creatures.
924-2079-4149-4599-4871.description:
Activate Phyrexian Ghoul by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phyrexian Ghoul ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat steps 1 through 3 two additional times.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Ghoulcaller Gisa by paying {B}, tapping it and sacrificing Phyrexian Ghoul.
When Phyrexian Ghoul dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Ghoulcaller Gisa ability, creating eight 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate Gravespawn Sovereign by tapping five Zombies, returning Phyrexian Ghoul from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Ghoul by sacrificing Ghoulcaller Gisa.
When Ghoulcaller Gisa dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phyrexian Ghoul ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Gravespawn Sovereign by tapping five Zombies, returning Ghoulcaller Gisa from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
924-2079-4149-4599-4871.notes: If Phyrexian Ghoul starts with a power of 4 or greater, you can reduce the number of additional creatures you control. It must get to 8 or higher power before sacrificing it to Gisa.

2438-4681-5170-7286.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, South Wind Avatar triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
South Wind Avatar triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and South Wind Avatar trigger.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
South Wind Avatar triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

57-1849-2751-4846.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-1849-2751-4846.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

957-2061-6991.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Donnie & April.
Put the Donnie & April token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Donnie & April token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat during your second extra turn.

1069-1374-5499-6965--24.notablePrerequisites:
You control three or more artifacts.
If the Knight has two colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of either color available.
If the Knight has three colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of any of those colors, and two mana of any other one of those colors available.
1069-1374-5499-6965--24.description:
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to the Knight.
Activate the Knight by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any color.
Cast the Knight from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
If the Knight has mana value 2 or less, this combo nets infinite mana.

2438-2866-4211-4986.description:
Cast Tormod's Crypt by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

2232-3542-3967-6843.easyPrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
2232-3542-3967-6843.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
Cast Anti-Venom by paying {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
When Anti-Venom enters, its first ability and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Anti-Venom trigger, returning Palinchron from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Palinchron enters, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Palinchron trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Anti-Venom from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Palinchron.
Repeat.

2511-4336-5220-6900.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep
When Kobolds of Kher Keep dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Kobolds of Kher Keep from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

856-2511-5220-6900.manaNeeded: {B} if Cauldron Familiar is in your hand
856-2511-5220-6900.easyPrerequisites: You have a life total of at least 2 if Cauldron Familiar is on top of your library.
856-2511-5220-6900.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {B} or 1 life respectively.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Cauldron Familiar from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

3967-5220-6535-6900.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Serrated Scorpion.
When Serrated Scorpion dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Serrated Scorpion from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Serrated Scorpion trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Cast Serrated Scorpion from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Gwenom.
Repeat.

1021-4050-5412-6761.notablePrerequisites: You have at least six land cards in your graveyard.
1021-4050-5412-6761.description:
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing Drownyard Temple.
Each Scouring Swarm you control triggers, creating a tapped token copy of itself.
Resolve the Coastal Hornclaw ability.
If you control four or more Scouring Swarms, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Scouring Swarm, adding {1}.
Repeat step 4 until you control three Scouring Swarms or until you have {3} available, whichever comes first.
Activate Drownyard Temple by paying {3}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
1021-4050-5412-6761.notes: The mana cost assumes you control no other Scouring Swarms. If you control one other Scouring Swarm, the cost is reduced to {2}. If you control two or more, the cost is {0}. To get infinite Scouring Swarms, you will need to control at least four at one time. If you wish to achieve this, only sacrifice Scouring Swarms if you control five or more of them. This raises the total cost of the combo by {1} assuming you start with only one Scouring Swarm.

222-527-2511-5295.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-2511-5295.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1117-2866-2906-6518.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has lost life this turn.
1117-2866-2906-6518.description:
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying {0}.
When Scrap Trawler enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Scrap Trawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Junk Diver by paying {0}.
When Junk Diver enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Junk Diver and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Junk Diver dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

560-1940-2034-4550.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
560-1940-2034-4550.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Zombie and Soldier, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Zombie and Soldier die, Liliana, Dreadhorde General triggers twice, causing you to draw two cards.
Repeat.

372-695-4125.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Settle Beyond Reality exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-695-4125.description:
Cast Settle Beyond Reality by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Shipwreck Dowser and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Shipwreck Dowser trigger.
Resolve the Shipwreck Dowser trigger, returning Settle Beyond Reality from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Settle Beyond Reality.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Shipwreck Dowser and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

618-1872-2816.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Composite Golem with haste.
Activate the Composite Golem token by sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Kiki-Jiki by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Composite Golem tokens and/or target any other nonlegendary creatures you control.

856-1201-1433-1636.notablePrerequisites:
Witch's Oven does not have summoning sickness.
Mightstone's Animation attached to Witch's Oven.
856-1201-1433-1636.description:
Activate Witch's Oven by tapping it and sacrificing Cauldron Familiar, creating a Food artifact token.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food token, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familar enters the battlefield, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

4186-4279-4506.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least two additional creatures.
Scurry Oak has no +1/+1 counters on it.
Your life total is at least 2.
4186-4279-4506.description:
Cast Yawgmoth by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Yawgmoth enters the battlefield, Auriok Champion and Scurry Oak's evolve ability trigger.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Auriok Champion trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, triggering Scurry Oak's second ability.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Auriok Champion and Scurry Oak's evolve ability trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

1981-2773-3333.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
1981-2773-3333.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Warstorm Surge triggers, dealing damage to you equal to the creature's power, with your life total not changing due to Platinum Emperion.
Darien triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Soldier creature tokens equal to the damage dealt to you.
When the Soldiers enter the battlefield, Warstorm Surge triggers that many times.
Resolve the first trigger, dealing 1 damage to you, with your life total not changing due to Platinum Emperion.
Repeat from step 3.

578-876-2043.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three artifact cards in hand.
578-876-2043.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Metalworker.
Activate Metalworker by tapping it and revealing at least three artifact cards from your hand, adding at least six {C}.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Urza.
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Metalworker that is a 1/1 Soldier.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to the Metalworker token.
Activate the Metalworker token by tapping it and revealing at least three artifact cards from your hand, adding at least six {C}.
Repeat from step 4.
If you have four or more artifact cards in hand, this combo nets infinite colorless mana, and you may target any artifact you control to get infinite copies of them.

1636-4319-4424-5147.notablePrerequisites: You control another nontoken nonartifact creature.
1636-4319-4424-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another nontoken nonartifact creature.
When the creature dies, Missy's first ability triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Skirk Alarmist by tapping it, turning the creature face up.
Repeat.

1651-2034-3263-4024.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Humans.
1651-2034-3263-4024.description:
Activate Horn of Gondor by paying {3} and tapping it, creating at least three 1/1 Human Soldier creature tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Human Soldiers, untapping Horn of Gondor.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing two Human Soldiers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

2-1057-1651-4306.notablePrerequisites: You have at least five devotion to any color.
2-1057-1651-4306.description:
Activate Nyx Lotus by tapping it, adding at least five mana of any color with which you have devotion.
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}.
Brimaz's first ability triggers, creating an Incubator artifact token.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Clock of Omens by tapping Ancestral Statue and the Incubator token, untapping Nyx Lotus.
Resolve the Ancestral Statue trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1170-1283-2450.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Cast Whim of Volrath with buyback by paying {3}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Chromatic Orrery.
Resolve Whim of Volrath, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Chromatic Orrery's second ability to draw infinite cards.

2436-5090.notablePrerequisites:
Singing Bell Strike attached to Marwyn.
Marwyn does not have summoning sickness.
Marwyn has a power of at least seven.
2436-5090.description:
Activate Marwyn by tapping it, adding at least seven {G}.
Activate Marwyn by paying {6}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1468-4274-4846.notablePrerequisites: Zirilan of the Claw does not have summoning sickness.
1468-4274-4846.description:
Activate Zirilan by paying {1}{R}{R} and tapping it, searching your library for Worldgorger Dragon, putting it onto the battlefield and shuffling your library.
Worldgorger Dragon enters the batllefield, exiling all other permanents you control.
Cast Apocalypse by paying {2}{R}{R}{R}, exiling all permanents and discarding your hand.
Worldgorger Dragon leaves the battlefield, returning all permanents exiled by it to the battlefield.
